mintAuthority.summary: Commission-operated role holders can mint native liabilities on seven EVM-compatible deployments, including Hedera, and through the Solana Token-2022 mint authority. UUPS upgraders can replace EVM issuance rules. Fireblocks HSM custody is disclosed, but full live membership and signing independence are not verified.

controls.evidence: Finalized getMultipleAccounts context slot 453407053 binds the exact FRNT mint to DsRa7mCpCfcTxdNJvaTzbRe73FuBbrs8U8NEAxFunWnr. That authority account is non-executable, owned by TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb, and parsed as an initialized native multisig requiring one of two signers: 7VhCbqKQEz3RNLSuAuiRmBVEVWdgcFqGHMiVPPo2KjHy and G15NrcKeqQoPG5ERcTLN1SNWZWv7BqbjvnnyQ1vJyAKf. Native multisig account data has no module or guard mechanism; this is not a custom executable controller. The first signer account is absent and the second is a non-executable system account. These observations establish cryptographic topology, not operator independence, private key custody, recovery policy, historical incident mapping or complete Token-2022 program reach. The distinct scaled-UI authority remains 3FL7iZaerXVygpPAFtXyxoCGdoUt11eiSBYkko6mMD8x.

review.evidence: Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history from genesis to pinned October 3 blocks was retrieved for Ethereum 26110208, Avalanche 96655718, Base 52110947, Polygon 94870735, Arbitrum 511231213 and Optimism 157706232. All six have sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE 0x5e3372f9a1c04e789ef86df9ec35f87e000bb15b, sole UPGRADER_ROLE 0x7f6cc8151ac948429911dab959d9e305501079ba and direct issuer MINTER_ROLE 0x83465b1bac70dc63c0d6b72e9f012af4a1e7138a, plus one chain-local CCIP pool minter. Admin/upgrader membership was corroborated by hasRole on each pinned block. Verified ERC20F._authorizeUpgrade is UPGRADER_ROLE-only with no contract delay. Wave-2 research retrieved all 85 Hedera token logs from deployment through Unix second 1791071400 from the public mirror node with links.next=null. Event reconstruction identifies the same sole issuer minter, administrator and upgrader, plus additional current MINTER_ROLE member 0xb9e7e53ad3f4bbc352a55c33db7bcf25e0da3f03 whose current native-versus-transfer reach remains unreviewed. At finalized Solana slot 453086221, the named mint authority is a Token-2022 multisig requiring one of two signer addresses, not an executable custom program; one signer account is absent and the other is a nonexecutable system account. Backend custody and recovery authorization remain undisclosed. No controller identities are removed or incident-free assertion made. TNF's own FRNT dashboard explicitly identifies issued AT-C 205 examinations, a dated daily report archive through October 3, and a process independently collecting circulating token balances and daily Fiduciary Trust custodian statements. This establishes attestation-only oversight of the exact Commission issuer, not prudential licensing, a reviewed report opinion or financial assurance over supplemental dashboard figures. Signed report downloads remained behind human verification; reconciliation remains unknown. The CISO's September 14 key-management disclosure and the reported contrary claim that only a scaled-display authority was affected do not establish a resolved mint incident or justify incidentState none.
review.reviewer: W2R23 authority census; W3R03 authenticated Solana topology and Hedera pool identity review
unresolvedQuestions: The additional Hedera MINTER_ROLE holder 0xb9e7e53ad3f4bbc352a55c33db7bcf25e0da3f03 returns BurnMintTokenPool 1.6.1, the exact FRNT token and Commission administrator as owner at mirror block 100734137. Executable source correspondence and the full router/off-ramp, mutable remote-pool and rate-limit reach are not certified; these identity reads alone do not close native-versus-transfer liability reach.

Solana mint authority is an initialized, non-executable Token-2022 one-of-two multisig at finalized slot 453407053. Which independently evidenced operator and recovery policies govern signer keys 7VhCbqKQEz3RNLSuAuiRmBVEVWdgcFqGHMiVPPo2KjHy and G15NrcKeqQoPG5ERcTLN1SNWZWv7BqbjvnnyQ1vJyAKf, and how does the production one-of-two authority relate to Chapter 2's required multiple-signer operating procedures?
